metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat team is travelling in the tribal areas of Mandla district in Madhya Pradesh. We met people of Gond tribe here. The people of Gond tribe worship nature and Bada Dev is there supreme deity. We will bring a full episode on this very special Puja.
